title: Hellblade studio Ninja Theory begins layoffs ⚔️
subject: hellblade
description:
What's your favorite Ninja Theory game? 👇

Staff at Hellblade developer Ninja Theory confirmed layoffs on LinkedIn after Xbox proposed closing the studio on September 22, 2026, when two separate agreements for it fell through. The studio's next game, Senua, was announced in June for 2027.

Sources: VGC (Oct 5, 2026), PC Gamer (Oct 5, 2026)
Game footage © Xbox Game Studios / Ninja Theory.

scenes.text: Hellblade studio Ninja Theory has started laying off staff.
On September 22, Xbox proposed closing the UK studio, after two separate deals for it fell through.
scenes.search: empty office building at night rain

scenes.text: Now developers are confirming on LinkedIn that their roles are ending, from sound designers to programmers.
Ninja Theory made Heavenly Sword, DmC and both Hellblade games.
Its next game, Senua, was announced in June for 2027, and its future is now unclear.
